project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Llangattock
